item.title: skills
item.description:
This repository bundles the following skills:

  • cuOpt: GPU-accelerated vehicle routing and optimization.
  • cuDF: NVIDIA GPU DataFrames with pandas acceleration.
  • DeepStream: Guided video analytics pipeline development.
  • TAO Toolkit: Fine-tunes 100+ pretrained vision AI models.
  • Nemotron: End-to-end model development and customization.
  • RAG Blueprint: Deploys retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.
  • Jetson Device: Post-boot diagnostics and LLM serving.
  • Holoscan SDK: Medical imaging application development.
  • Warp: GPU-accelerated simulation and robotics.
  • DALI: GPU-accelerated data loading and processing.

item.title: text-to-cad
item.description:
This repository bundles the following skills:

  • CAD: Creates and edits CAD models with STEP output plus STL, 3MF, and GLB export.
  • CAD Viewer: Provides local browser previews of CAD and robot files.
  • step.parts: Sources off-the-shelf STEP components such as screws, bearings, and motors.
  • DXF: Generates 2D drawings from Python or CAD geometry.
  • URDF/SRDF: Writes robot structure and MoveIt planning files.
  • G-code: Slices meshes into G-code using real slicer command-line tools.
